title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: October 29, 2026 - Intraday Update (as of 1:46 PM ET)

items.headline: Tech Stocks Drag U.S. Indices Lower on Disappointing Earnings, Economic Growth Surges
items.summary: U.S. equities are broadly lower in intraday trading today, primarily weighed down by significant declines in major technology stocks following weaker-than-expected earnings reports from Alphabet and ServiceNow. This comes despite a strong Q3 GDP report showing the U.S. economy grew at its fastest pace in a year, and the Federal Reserve's decision yesterday to hold interest rates steady. Inflation concerns persist, however, as the PCE price index rose above the Fed's target. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady, Expresses Inflation Concern
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's FOMC voted to keep benchmark interest rates unchanged at 3.75-4% on Wednesday, October 28. Despite the pause, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh indicated that inflation remains 'too high' and that further economic data would be considered for future policy decisions, with a potential rate hike in December.

items.headline: U.S. Economy Grows at Fastest Pace in a Year
items.summary: The U.S. economy expanded at a robust annual rate of 3.4% in the third quarter of 2026, marking its fastest growth in a year. This acceleration was primarily driven by strong business investment and sustained consumer spending.

items.headline: PCE Inflation Rises to Four-Month High
items.summary: Inflation data released today showed the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index increased by 0.5% in September, bringing the annual rate to 3.6%. This figure, the highest in four months, remains above the Federal Reserve's 2% target.

items.headline: Tech Sector Under Pressure Following Key Earnings
items.summary: The technology sector is experiencing significant pressure today, with major companies like Alphabet ($GOOGL) and ServiceNow ($NOW) seeing substantial stock declines after their latest earnings reports. Concerns over AI chatbot disruption and decelerating revenue growth are weighing heavily on investor sentiment in the tech space.

items.headline: Amazon, Intel, Starbucks Set to Report Earnings After Market Close
items.summary: Investors are awaiting third-quarter earnings reports from several major companies after the market closes today, including Amazon ($AMZN), Intel ($INTC), and Starbucks ($SBUX). These reports are anticipated to provide further insights into corporate performance and broader market trends.
